sources.title: WFX Phantom: The GitHub Actions Secret Stealer That Deletes Its Tracks

indicators: Release ships a .ci-*.sh script and a postinstall hook that dumps CI secrets and runner memory
Part of the WFX Phantom campaign, which also injected workflows into GitHub repositories and reverted the commits within minutes
draft.summary: Release 3.14.3 of digitalelvis/neuronai-studio on Packagist carries a CI secret stealer from the WFX Phantom campaign, run by an npm postinstall hook inside the package.
draft.remediation: Do not use digitalelvis/neuronai-studio 3.14.3; go back to 3.14.2. If 3.14.3 ran in CI, rotate the secrets and cloud credentials available to that pipeline and review recent workflow runs and commits.

review.notes: Recomendação da engenharia: DEIXAR PARA DEPOIS. Só uma empresa (StepSecurity) relatou até agora, e o OSV ainda não tem registro; a regra pede duas fontes. O rascunho já esta pronto: quando surgir uma segunda fonte, eu aviso e você aprova.
